input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 expressly states that no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies and that Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, with non-ordering expressly not a breach or shortfall. Section 12.3 reinforces that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment, and Section 7.6 bars unidentified minimum-use charges. There is no take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or volume cap anywhere in the Fees, Order Form, or scope provisions, so the clause sits at our preferred position (not merely the fallback) and no redline is warranted. (The liquidated-damages mechanic in Section 7.7 is a late-payment remedy addressed under a different rule, not a minimum-commitment shortfall.)
